description.text: One framework for DebugHost: .NET 8, 9, or 10. Tests and the optional benchmark use the same TFM. The analyzer package always targets netstandard2.0.

Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license and a slim .gitignore. src/global.json is optional and unchecked by default. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another analyzer package to the same repository.

Where this analyzer's .slnx is written. Default src/sln/{name}/ with the handbook beside that file. Other locations: repository root (src/sln/{name}/ stays as notes), or src/prj/{name}/ next to the analyzer csproj (slnx and handbook; no src/sln/{name}/). Several .slnx files in the same folder make `dotnet` require an explicit path (MSB1011). Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the template solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the analyzer package, tests, DebugHost, and benchmark. XML documentation is analyzer-project-only. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Default is This analyzer (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later packages keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the analyzer project.
Adds Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers to this analyzer project. The first build writes Properties/PublicAPI baseline files if they are missing. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.

Optional DocShell.html seed. NuGet package docs go under this analyzer's Properties/NugetMetadata/docs and pack with the nupkg. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another package unless you only want package docs. Bootstrap and mini docs are a checkpoint task.
Default MIT. Standard licenses set PackageLicenseExpression and keep License.txt on disk. Custom packs License.txt as the NuGet license file. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license.

name.text: Code style rules for analyzer project

description.text: Single choice. Default is Strict: naming, XML docs, nullable, unused usings, and reserved identifiers (CA1716) fail the build. Default (style suggestions) is the same dump without those errors. Off writes no file. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.
SDK CA rules on the analyzer project only. Default Recommended. Minimum is fewer warnings. All is almost every CA rule. Separate from code style Strict and from Public API analyzers.

name.text: Treat high/critical NuGet vulnerabilities as errors

description.text: Default on. Restore fails this analyzer package on high (NU1903) and critical (NU1904) vulnerable packages. Low and moderate stay warnings. Uncheck for an EOL or backport graph. Test and benchmark projects are not affected. NugetReport next to the tests lists that package and is still info-only.

Single choice. Default is Coverlet: dotnet test fails below 100% line, branch, and method coverage on the analyzer assembly. Edit Threshold in the test csproj if you want less. Coverlet and ReportGenerator also writes HTML/Markdown. None writes no extra test packages. ReportGenerator needs Coverlet output, so the two are not independent checkboxes.

Default off. Writes empty Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets beside this analyzer project, and Directory.Solution.props and Directory.Solution.targets beside this package's .slnx. Landing files for extra MSBuild. Tests and benchmark are not affected. No Directory.Packages.props.

Default on. Writes an empty .config/dotnet-tools.json beside this analyzer project (no tools). Landing file for dotnet tool install --local. Uncheck to skip. Tests, DebugHost, and benchmark are not affected. Does not restore tools on build.
